BACKEND: iter87 suite now green (9/9 pass) — quotes, reviewer NAMES and non-generic COMPANY labels are all unique across the 34 template sets (256 name collisions and 11 non-generic company collisions from iter87 are FIXED by /app/backend/dedupe_reviews.py; the only remaining company overlaps are true generic consumer labels like 'parent of one', 'freelancer', 'volunteer' which the spec explicitly allows and are now handled by _is_generic() in the test). New iter88 suite (13/13 pass) covers: (a) PUT /api/apps/{id}/reviews rejects invalid accent/card_bg/title_color with 400 '<field> must be a hex or rgb colour'; (b) valid #RRGGBB, #RGB, #RRGGBBAA, rgb() and rgba() values all accepted and persisted; (c) title/subtitle remain free text; (d) reset clears colour overrides; (e) saas template shows >=8 unique portrait URLs (photo pool widened from 17→25 confirmed) and every URL returns 200; (f) aggregating 10 templates surfaces >=20 distinct portrait URLs. Regression: iter80-86 suites all pass (109/109). FRONTEND end-to-end on live URL: logged in via API and set cookie; navigated to /apps/app_testlab → SITE MODE tab → ReviewsEditor mounted with all 20 rows. Verified live-integrated: EDIT reviews-name-0/company-0/quote-0/tag-0-0 → reviews-save-btn → API GET returned custom quote+name and source='custom' ✓. reviews-add-btn+save: 20→21 rows persisted ✓. reviews-del-N+save: 21→20 rows persisted ✓. reviews-up-1+save: rows 0 and 1 swapped and persisted after reload ✓. COLOUR: setting accent=#ff00aa card_bg=#111111 title_color=#ffaa00 via PUT and opening /p/pv_c3b797fcdafc58d4e70e320f shows stars fill='#ff00aa', tag border/text = rgb(255,0,170), reviews-title colour = rgb(255,170,0) — accent/card_bg/title_color all applied live without a reload ✓. reviews-colour-clear-* buttons remove overrides ✓; reviews-reset-btn restores template's 20 reviews AND template palette (toast 'Template reviews and colours restored' verified) ✓. Client portal (/portal) shows portal-figures-card containing ReviewsEditor for app_testlab; portal ADD+SAVE persisted (20→21) ✓. REDUCED-MOTION: on /p/{token} with prefers-reduced-motion=reduce, quotes render fully (167-char full quote sampled), no review-cursor, no data-autoscroll attribute → track does not auto-scroll ✓. Non-member protection remains verified via iter87 pytest (clean requests session gets 401/403/404). Teardown: POST /apps/app_testlab/reviews/reset returned 200 — tenant restored to template AI set with default style.
critical_code_review_comments: reviews.py PUT colour validation regex '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}|rgba?\([\d.,%\s]+\)' accepts #RGBA (4-char) as well as #RRGGBB — a client sending '#FFFF' would pass but render invisible. Not a blocker; the editor only emits 6-char hex via <input type=color>.

Setting a controlled <input type=color> value from Playwright's element.evaluate requires the React native value setter (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(...).set) — worth documenting in the test harness so future agents don't hit the flakiness we saw with the second batch of colour saves.

Adding a review via reviews-add-btn seeds an empty row (no name/company/quote) — no UI validation on save. The 60-max cap is enforced but empty rows would render as blank cards on the live site. Consider a min-content validator on PUT.

The reviews-editor sits inside a max-h-[520px] scroll container so with 20 rows you must scroll to reach row 19 — reviews-del-19 requires scroll_into_view_if_needed() in tests. Not a bug; noting for future agents.
